title.en: Restart an agent that hit an error

description.en: Agents in an error state show a Restart button on their device card.
description.zh: 出错的智能体在设备卡片上会显示「重启」按钮。

title.en: Tidier top bar, Settings and Connect Agents
title.zh: 顶部栏、设置页与连接智能体页更清爽

description.en: Workspace tabs now sit with the Workspace button and can be folded away. Settings opens straight on General with a grouped menu, and Logs moved into Settings. Connect Agents gives your agent list more room, and its filters stay in view as you scroll.
description.zh: 工作区标签归入「工作区」按钮，可收起；设置页直接进入「通用」并按分组显示菜单，「日志」并入设置；「连接智能体」页为智能体列表留出更多空间，筛选栏随列表滚动保持可见。

description.en: Yumi is now labelled as the help assistant, chats show every agent step by default, and you can edit your name and avatar from the sidebar.
description.zh: Yumi 更名为「Yumi答疑小助手」，对话默认显示完整步骤，可在侧边栏直接修改姓名和头像。

title.zh: 智能体安装与检测更快

description.en: Installs skip unnecessary checks, and detecting the agents on this computer no longer waits on a slow one.
description.zh: 安装省去不必要的检查；检测本机智能体时，个别较慢的不再拖住整体结果。

title.en: Connecting this computer works the first time
title.zh: 首次连接本机即可成功

description.en: A newly connected computer no longer drops offline a minute later.
description.zh: 新连接的电脑不再在一分钟后掉线。

title.en: Cursor replies arrive as soon as they are ready
title.zh: Cursor 回复生成后即时送达

description.en: Yumi no longer disappears from the sidebar, All Workspaces no longer stays blank, the workspace keeps your language, rewards progress updates on its own, and a new agent keeps its place in the list.
description.zh: Yumi 不再从侧边栏消失；「全部工作区」不再空白；工作区不再自动切换成英文；新手奖励进度自动更新；新添加的智能体不再在列表中跳动。
